_readme: How each NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Moderate control gets its evidence. Precedence: controls > policy_controls (any xx-1) > family_defaults > automatic. Automatic means Security Hub CSPM findings if any check maps to the control, otherwise not-assessed (manual).

policy_controls.reason: Policy and procedures control. Evidence is a reviewed policy document recorded in attestations/<control-id>.json.

pe.reason: Physical and environmental protection is provided by AWS data centers (AWS FedRAMP package).
